ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels in central and marginal zones vs 40% high-intensity (white) pixels on lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions on the distal lobes, separated by a broad central low-intensity (black) vertical channel extending from the peduncle to the notch. The left high-intensity zone contains one distinct, internal low-intensity (black) focal spot.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding box depth representing roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing boundary; the left lobe displays more jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the smoother right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edge, terminating in slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-intensity (white) roughly circular pixel groups located on the dark-pigmented far left tip, likely indicating barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Thin, dark-toned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the white region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized trauma-induced pixel clusters at the far left tip and irregular trailing edge notches indicating minor physical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast dark circular spot (approx. 8 pixels diameter) embedded within the white field of the left lobe; significant pixel occlusion on the left lobe caused by an foreground avian object (gull).
